_readme: Animation library: retargeted Mixamo sets (web/assets/anims/mixamo/<set>.json, git-ignored, made by tools/anim_retarget.py) and hand-keyed clips (engine/anims.js KEYED). Use: await loadAnimSet(set); sample(name, t). Credit Mixamo clips in the video .txt.
